subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Revises single letter sounds; distinguishes beginning and end sounds

show.line: Four sounds! j, j, jam. v, v, van. w, w, web. y, y, yoyo.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with j, as in jam?
Which one starts with w, as in web?
Say the sound with me. v, as in van!
Which one starts with y, as in yoyo?
Tap the letter that says v.
Jam. What is the last sound? Say it.
Does it start with j, v, w or y? Sort the pictures.

hints: Listen for the first sound. j jumps. v buzzes.
w is one point down twice. v is one point.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with v.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Web starts with w. Van starts with v.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. v, v, van. Van starts with v!

parent_line: Can hear and recognise the sounds j, v, w and y.
